verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document runbooks that attach to incidents with automatically triggered steps such as creating channels, assigning tasks, or running diagnostics. Workflows are shown only for auto-publishing status pages. Investigations read runbooks as AI context rather than executing their steps. Both are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an SRE, runbooks attach to incidents and their steps can trigger automatically — creating channels, assigning tasks, running diagnostics
